acceptance: Red: the current Gate test fixture contains real main:prod push argv at both recorded paths, and a test harness can therefore escape its intended isolated bare remote. Green: both fixture paths use an isolated bare remote or non-publishing local ref setup; the safety harness deterministically rejects any production ref argv and any network-capable remote access; the two focused regression tests pass. The acceptance must run only the isolated fixture and deny-guard tests, never the full Gate and never a production or shared remote.
acceptance_cmd:
bash -c 'set -eu
test -f ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py
uv run --no-project --python 3.13 python -m py_compile ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py
N=$(uv run --no-project --python 3.13 --with pytest pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py -k "safety_fixture_no_production_push or production_ref_push_denied" | grep -c "::")
[ "${N}" -ge 2 ]
uv run --no-project --python 3.13 --with pytest pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py -k "safety_fixture_no_production_push or production_ref_push_denied"'
brief: Gate fixture 可能觸及真實 production ref push，維護者執行測試時有遠端生產風險。
detail: 2026-08-10 safety-stop 實測：a54 integration 的 fresh Gate 在 ops-pytest 期間觀察到 PID 97051 執行 /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/usr/bin/git push -q origin main:prod，parent pytest 88712，remote URL 指向 https://github.com/MaxChen228/Books-Vocab.git。唯讀定位到 ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py 的 scratch fixture 第 1649 行直接以 _git 執行該 push，test_resolve_protects_the_trunk_even_under_a_different_base 第 2841 行也重複一次。測試意圖是建立 isolated bare remote 的 prod ref，但 Gate 沒有機械禁止真實 production-shaped refspec，導致 fixture/環境 escape 時可能觸及真正 origin。此票只處理測試與 Gate harness 安全邊界，不改生產程式、不重跑事故 Gate。
plan:
1. Refactor the scratch fixture release-plane setup at the two recorded call sites so it uses an isolated bare remote or local ref setup whose URL cannot resolve to the repository origin; do not invoke a production-shaped push as fixture plumbing.
2. Add a Gate-test safety harness that denies argv containing main:prod, origin/prod, or an equivalent production refspec and denies network-capable remote access; keep the denial observable as a structured regression failure.
3. Add two focused regression tests named safety_fixture_no_production_push and production_ref_push_denied. The first proves both fixture paths use the isolated remote; the second proves the argv/network deny guard rejects a production ref push without contacting a remote.
4. Run only the ticket acceptance command: file existence, Python syntax compilation, collection-count check for both targeted tests, then those targeted tests. Do not run the full Gate or any release command.
scope: 一個 ops fixture、Gate harness deny guard 與兩條 targeted regression；不改 production code。
